article.story: PITTSBURGH -- — Jahsean Corbett totaled 13 points and 10 rebounds to help Duquesne defeat Rhode Island 67-55 on Tuesday. David Dixon added 11 points, six rebounds and three blocks for the Dukes (6-8, 1-0 Atlantic 10 Conference).. Tre Dinkins had 11 points. The Rams (11-2, 0-1) were led by Sebastian Thomas with 20 points and four assists. Duquesne took the lead with 12:13 remaining in the first half and never looked back. Matus Hronsky led their team in scoring with seven points in the first half to help put them up 34-26 at the break. ——- The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
